decision.summary: Representative learned-evaluation weights are published as CC BY 4.0 with the training-source attribution recorded per model. The AGPL-3.0-only source license covers code only; third-party datasets and assets keep their own terms. See docs/model/distribution.md for the conditions actually verified and the residual caveats.
decision.scope: Weights in this manifest only. Training data, teacher binaries and evaluation tables are not redistributed.

native_cli.note: Apple Silicon macOS build (make pure-build). Verified on this Mac only; other platforms build from source.

baseline_lineage_sources: CSA WCSC game records, tournaments 1-29 and 31-32 (use free with program/date/event/source attribution; https://www.computer-shogi.org/kifu/kifu.html)
Denryu-sen hardware-3 archive kifu_dr5hdw3.zip (game-record use without restrictions; https://denryu-sen.jp/denryusen/dr_link/dr1_live.php)
AobaZero no-noise self-play CSA samples, exact 100-file catalog w4745.csa..w4235.csa (public domain per project statement; http://www.yss-aya.com/aobazero/no_noise/)
Offline Apery 2.0.0 fixed-depth teacher labels generated locally (GPL-3.0 teacher binary and MIT evaluation tables are not redistributed; labels are treated as project data)
OpenShogiAI self-play games and replay data generated by earlier project models

models.provenance_note: R4-C4 run r4-c4-attempt-01, generation G02 trained candidate. Selected for publication by the user on 2026-09-24. defense-20260912-recovery-r3 best step 1536. The historical R4-C2 selection shipped identical bytes and runtime; C2 is published as this same configuration, not as a separate model.
